patch_description:
This version replaces the unstructured random sample with a deterministic maximin search.

It fixes four points at the corners of the unit square, guaranteeing a convex unit-area containing region, and optimizes the remaining nine interior points. The objective evaluates all 286 triangle determinants and uses a temperature-controlled soft-min objective so that optimization improves not only the single worst triangle but also the set of near-worst triangles. Several deterministic seeded restarts, annealed coordinate perturbations, and a final min-area polishing phase substantially improve the minimum normalized triangle area while retaining reproducibility and a compact dependency footprint.

The returned array remains a NumPy array of shape `(13, 2)` and all points remain inside the unit square.
